verdict.rationale: PostHog clearly ships feature flags, so edge evaluation is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions evaluating flags in CDN workers, edge runtimes, or a relay/proxy layer. The closest item, posthog-docs-5, describes runtime evaluation from your own tooling and CI, which is not edge evaluation close to users.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users
